zh-CN.name: Humanizer
zh-CN.shortDesc: 把听起来像 AI 写的文字改得像作者本人写的，但不改原意。用于编辑或检查散文中的 AI 痕迹：不是 X 而是 Y 的对比、单行收束、做作开头、强行三连、破折号泛滥、夸大表述、销售腔、套话、加粗标签或空话。

en-US.name: Humanizer
en-US.shortDesc: Rewrite AI-sounding text so it reads like the writer without changing what it says. Use when editing or reviewing prose for AI tells: not-X-but-Y contrasts, one-line closers, staged openers, forced triads, dashes everywhere, inflated claims, sales language, stock AI words, bold labels, or filler.
